settings.headline: Know what the numbers actually mean.
settings.intro: Revenue is only part of the story. TraceKit helps connect commerce and financial evidence so teams can investigate profit, adjustments, and discrepancies.
settings.note: Profit calculations depend on available costs, source coverage, and configured definitions.

settings.heading: Preserve the source
settings.body: Keep original provider identifiers and raw evidence available for investigation.

settings.heading: Connect related events
settings.body: Relate base orders, upsells, subscriptions, refunds, and disputes without collapsing distinct transactions.

settings.heading: Surface discrepancies
settings.body: Keep unmatched and unresolved records visible for review.

settings.heading: Make better decisions
settings.body: Explore the factors behind reported performance, with limitations clearly identified.
